title: Shower Door Pull 13-Inch Solid Brass & Acrylic | Shaded Beige | Brass Shower Door Accessories | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop fighting a slippery, hard-to-grab shower entry in Shaded Beige, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes. This Clearview Collection single side shower door pull gives your glass shower door a secure, comfortable grip with a clean, finished look that suits transitional bathrooms.

  • Shaded Beige transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 84 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Choose materials made for daily bathroom use with solid brass construction and clear acrylic accent components.
  • Coordinate a cohesive space by pairing with other transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories in the Brass Shower Door Accessories collection.

Specs & Installation

  • Product: Clearview Collection single side shower door pull with smooth accents
  • Materials: Solid brass with clear acrylic accents
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 13 x 3.9 x 1.7 in.
  • Box dimensions (L x H x W): 14 x 6 x 6 in.
  • Shipping weight: 4 lbs
  • Mounting: Concealed screw mounting; hardware included
  • Finish: Available in multiple designer finish options
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
